posts.text: It seems strange that the tools we have for creating synthetic media are much more restrictive about what we can create than the platform that host and distribute the resulting material. My column on YouTube opening its doors to deepfakes today: platformer.news/p/youtube-op…

New from me: Etsy secretly banned the phrase “from the river to the sea” on sellers’ wares, and some employees aren’t happy.

A story about content moderation in wartime:  platformer.news/p/how-bannin…

I wrote about the argument that this week’s AI regulations represent “regulatory capture” and make the case that if even Elon Musk is asking the government to do something, we have every right to mandate a little transparency. platformer.news/p/the-case-f…

Isaac Chotiner: You say the two cats who live in your house are "Jerks" and you don't care for them
Me: Absolutely. They are the burdens of my life
Chotiner: It seems you spent an hour searching for special food for them and paid more for it than you do even for your own food.
Me: That's--Hold on,
On Threads someone is getting their ears pierced for the first time at the age of 65 and is looking fabulous and their post has 17K likes
If you want revenge, then dig two graves. the first one is a practice grave to get a feel for it and the second is your main or "show grave"
You know whose fault it actually is that bluesky is dying? the reply guys, who consistently let down power users with substandard riffs and slightly off-topic GIFs
this is the only builder that people want to hear from
What I'm saying is they should have bought Bluesky
Another weird thing about the OpenAI/TBPN acquisition: if your goal is to "change the narrative about AI," why buy a channel that only reaches people who already agree with you?
NEWS: Meta has discussed ending funding to its independent Oversight Board after its current commitment expires in 2028, sources tell Platformer www.platformer.news/meta-oversig...
For that kind of money you could employ a handful of AI researchers!
This is the biggest stretch of an acquisition since when Jack Dorsey made Square buy Tidal because he wanted to be friends with Jay Z
About 10 minutes after announcing that it was time to cut back on side projects and pivot to the enterprise, OpenAI has acquired a media company 🤔 openai.com/index/openai...

Had a great time joining Decoder with @reckless.bsky.social and @caseynewton.bsky.social to dissect the really tricky question of what happens now that Meta's lost two jury trials over its product design.

The compromise @caseynewton.bsky.social is proposing would be a big deal in the tech policy world. The feud between Section 230 absolutists and those seeking to rein in social media companies is a big reason why regulation always withers on the vine.
